scripts.dev: concurrently -n front,back -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=front" "npm run dev --workspace=back"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=back && npm run build --workspace=front
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=front && npm run typecheck --workspace=back
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=front && npm run lint --workspace=back
